name: TerrainHeightmapGenerator
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play procedural terrain: generates a heightmap via NoiseUtils.Fbm and applies it directly to this GameObject's Terrain. Click Generate (or call it from code, in-Editor or at runtime) any time to reroll — it always reads TerrainData's current heightmap resolution, so it works with whatever Terrain size you've already set up in the Inspector.  Performance note: this runs synchronously on the main thread, resolution*resolution noise samples per call (each itself up to `octaves` Perlin lookups) — fine for typical Editor-time terrain authoring, but at a large heightmapResolution (1025, 2049) this is a genuinely heavy call and could cause a visible hitch if triggered at runtime rather than from the Editor. Recommended for Editor-time use above ~513.

src_serialized.name: noiseScale
src_serialized.tooltip: World-space scale of the noise — smaller values = larger, smoother hills; larger values = tighter, busier detail.

src_serialized.name: octaves
src_serialized.tooltip: Number of noise layers blended together (see NoiseUtils.Fbm) — more octaves add finer detail on top of the broad shape.

src_serialized.name: heightMultiplier
src_serialized.tooltip: Normalized height multiplier — 1 uses the terrain's full configured height range, lower values flatten it.

src_serialized.name: seedOffset
src_serialized.tooltip: Offsets the sampled noise coordinates so repeated generations look different. Set manually for a reproducible result, or leave randomizeSeedOnGenerate on.

src_serialized.name: randomizeSeedOnGenerate
src_serialized.tooltip: Randomizes seedOffset before generating, so every click of Generate gives a different terrain instead of the same one.
